 Versus

Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Anupriya Kukreti, learned Counsel for petitioner.
2. Mr. N.S. Pundir, learned Dy.A.G. for the State.
3. By means of this petition, petitioner has challenged 
the order dated 15.09.2025 passed by respondent no.3 by 
which an amount of Rs.11,81,690/- was directed to be 
released in favour of respondent no.5, who is the mother of 
deceased government servant, namely, Tejpal Singh Bisht. 
This petition is filed by the wife of late Tejpal Singh Bisht on 
the premise that since her nomination was not made in the 
documents by her husband, aforesaid amount was directed 
to be released to mother of her husband. 
4. Issue notice to respondent no.5 returnable within two 
weeks.
5. Steps within three days.
6. List on 09.09.2026.
7. Meanwhile, the respondents may file their counter 
affidavit. 
8. Further, the State Counsel is directed to file an 
affidavit with the averment or make a submission before the 
Court as to whether the amount in question has been 
disbursed to respondent no.5 or not.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 19.08.2026 R.Dang
